mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report (target_type, target_id, reason, detail, reporter_id, status, resolved_at) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, #{detail}, #{reporterId}, #{status}, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'OPEN' THEN NULL ELSE NOW() END)
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM report WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND reporter_id = #{reporterId} AND status = 'OPEN')

SELECT g.*, CASE g.target_type WHEN 'BLOCK' THEN b.title WHEN 'PLAYLIST' THEN p.title ELSE u.nickname END AS title, CASE g.target_type WHEN 'BLOCK' THEN b.uploader_id WHEN 'PLAYLIST' THEN p.user_id ELSE u.id END AS owner_id, CASE g.target_type WHEN 'BLOCK' THEN ub.nickname WHEN 'PLAYLIST' THEN up.nickname ELSE u.nickname END AS owner_nickname, CASE g.target_type WHEN 'BLOCK' THEN b.status WHEN 'PLAYLIST' THEN CASE WHEN p.is_hidden THEN 'HIDDEN' WHEN p.is_public THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE 'PRIVATE' END ELSE CASE WHEN u.upload_banned THEN 'BANNED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END END AS state, b.file_key AS media_key FROM ( SELECT target_type, target_id, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'COPYRIGHT') AS copyright, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'OFFENSIVE') AS offensive, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'SPAM') AS spam, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reason = 'OTHER') AS other, string_agg(detail, ' / ' ORDER BY created_at DESC) FILTER (WHERE detail IS NOT NULL AND detail <> '') AS details, MIN(created_at) AS first_at, MAX(COALESCE(resolved_at, created_at)) AS last_at FROM report WHERE status = #{status} GROUP BY target_type, target_id ) g LEFT JOIN block b ON g.target_type = 'BLOCK' AND b.id = g.target_id LEFT JOIN users ub ON ub.id = b.uploader_id LEFT JOIN playlist p ON g.target_type = 'PLAYLIST' AND p.id = g.target_id LEFT JOIN users up ON up.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN users u ON g.target_type = 'USER' AND u.id = g.target_id ORDER BY g.last_at DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE report SET status = #{to}, resolved_at = NOW() WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND status = #{from}
